classes.name: Triptans
classes.description: Acute migraine 5-HT1B/1D agonists: sumatriptan (tablet, nasal, injection; Imitrex, Tosymra, Zembrace), rizatriptan (Maxalt, MLT), zolmitriptan (Zomig), eletriptan (Relpax), naratriptan, almotriptan, frovatriptan, sumatriptan/naproxen (Treximet).
classes.plainDescription: A pill (or spray/shot) taken when a migraine starts.

classes.name: Acute CGRP antagonists (gepants) & ditans
classes.description: Acute CGRP receptor antagonists and ditans: rimegepant (Nurtec ODT, also preventive), ubrogepant (Ubrelvy), zavegepant nasal (Zavzpret), lasmiditan (Reyvow).
classes.plainDescription: A newer migraine pill (or nasal spray) for when triptans don't work or aren't safe.

classes.name: CGRP preventives
classes.description: Migraine-preventive CGRP agents: erenumab (Aimovig), fremanezumab (Ajovy), galcanezumab (Emgality), eptinezumab (Vyepti, IV), atogepant (Qulipta, oral).
classes.plainDescription: A monthly shot (or daily pill) that prevents migraines.
